arguments.lyrics:
[Intro - 4 bars, instrumental, no vocals, no count-in]

[Verse 1 - 4 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Here is an apple.
Apple, apple!
I see an apple.

[Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Verse 2 - 4 bars, sung, no instrumental gap]
Banana, banana!
Here is a banana.
Banana, banana!
I see a banana.

[Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Bridge - 4 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Can you say apple?
Banana, banana!
Can you say banana?

[Final Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Outro - 2 bars, sung]
Apple, banana!
Bye-bye, bye-bye!

[End - one final chord, stop]
arguments.style: Keep the source melody, tempo, groove and original sung phrasing recognizable. Change only the lead toward a bright clear cute youthful GIRL solo: light natural childlike timbre, lively articulated English, small clean tone, no heavy vocal effects. Keep the source bass, rhythm guitar and claps balanced. Avoid an exaggerated ultra-high voice. Sing apple and ba-NA-na naturally. Tight continuous singing, short breath gaps and concise natural ending.
arguments.negative_style: long instrumental break, long intro, changed melody, abrupt cutoff, operatic vocals, exaggerated pitch shifting, unintelligible words, deep male lead, husky adult belting
